geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.
Keep one small circular standing patch in the lower third, horizontally centered immediately above the front stairs.
The standing patch is only large enough for Bedrotte and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Let comforts fill the rear and sides while keeping only that small patch clear.
style: Premium cozy stylized 3D toy diorama matching the approved Bedrotte runtime tile.
Chunky rounded clay-like and cushion-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, and clean silhouettes.
Use Bedrotte's dusty indigo, soft lavender, muted plum, warm cream, and amber palette.
Every important feature must remain readable at 256 pixels.
persistentLandmarks: The rear-center pillow shelter develops into the signature moonlit dream sanctuary without changing its anchor.
The upper-left comfort seat remains upper-left.

The small lower-center character standing patch remains open at every stage.

stages.name: Quiet Hollow
stages.narrative: Bedrotte has found a quiet corner, but it is still cool, bare, and unsettled.
stages.floor: Mostly bare muted dusk-blue floor with two or three broad pale worn patches and no pattern.
stages.landmark: One low folded cushion beneath a simple rear-center timber arch.
props: one plain blanket roll at upper-right
one unlit broad lantern at upper-left
stages.lighting: Soft cool evening ambient light with almost no warm glow.
stages.density: Very sparse, quiet, and visibly unfinished.

stages.name: First Comfort Nook
stages.narrative: A warm light and somewhere soft to settle give rest a place to begin.
stages.floor: Broad muted blue floor remains dominant with one softly defined lower standing patch.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center arch gains a tucked bed, one pillow, and a small warm window.
props: one simple cushioned chair at upper-left
one folded blanket chest at upper-right
stages.lighting: Evening-blue ambient light with one warm window and lantern pool.
stages.density: A modest first refuge with only essential comfort shapes.

stages.name: Settled Sleep Room
stages.narrative: Bedrotte builds a dependable room where slowing down and recovering feel welcome.
stages.floor: One broad continuous dusty-blue carpet mass fills the room without fibers or pattern.
stages.landmark: The rear-center nook becomes a compact open-front sleep room with broad pillow canopy, tucked bed, and amber window.
props: one chunky cushioned armchair at upper-left
stages.lighting: Soft evening-blue light with three broad amber sanctuary pools.

stages.name: Restorative Retreat
stages.narrative: The room becomes a complete retreat that treats restoration as worthy in itself.
stages.floor: Plush low-detail indigo and lavender floor masses frame the small lower standing patch.
stages.landmark: The same sleep nook grows into a rounded retreat pavilion with layered pillow canopy and two glowing windows.
props: the established upper-left reading chair and blanket
the upper-right comfort chest and moon lamp
stages.lighting: Deep cozy evening light balanced by broad warm sanctuary glow.
stages.density: Richly comfortable through large soft silhouettes, never fabric clutter.

stages.name: Moonlit Dream Sanctuary
stages.narrative: Bedrotte's home becomes a definitive sanctuary for rest, safety, and gentler mornings.
stages.floor: A polished broad dusk-blue sanctuary floor surrounds the small lower standing patch without a central rug or platform.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center pavilion culminates in a signature pillow-domed dream sanctuary with one oversized crescent window and warm glowing entrance.
props: the resolved upper-right blanket and moon-light nook
stages.lighting: Magical moonlit evening with restrained broad amber and ivory glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature refuge with a strong dreamy silhouette and no tiny details.
